[^h2he-run]: [sha: 6fbb39750f62b83df096058a4746e77d0a634bc5; deck: the element weights and temperature grids in `src/snapy_report/ch02/h2he_check.py`; run: `python src/snapy_report/ch02/h2he_check.py`, CPU float64, one process; Python 3.9.25, numpy 2.0.2, sympy 1.14.0]. Fourteen checks cover deck molar-mass and heat-capacity arithmetic (C1–C10) and sampled or limiting H2 rotor heat capacities (C11–C14). They do not re-derive the ideal-moist compressibility factors, energy equation, or frozen-composition adiabatic index. Output: `src/snapy_report/ch02/h2he_check.out`. This is an independent port and algebra check, not execution of snapy or kintera. Rounded arithmetic is checked to half the last displayed decimal unit; rotor limiting checks use 0.01, and extrema are sampled every 0.5 K.
